source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper fixes potential outcomes and potential missingness in design-based inference, uses CRE, resolves ties by a randomly ordered index rule, and proves a valid worst-case p-value based on extreme imputations under general missingness.
The paper gives a two-sample Wilcoxon--Mann--Whitney missing-data method based on attainable statistic bounds and discusses p-value behavior and ties under the ordinary two-sample reference setting.
The published paper establishes a finite-sample FRT/confidence-distribution framework, including inversion yielding confidence intervals with guaranteed coverage.

The article introduces imputation-and-re-imputation randomization tests under a general missingness mechanism, proves finite-population-exact Type-I control, and constructs finite-population-valid confidence regions.
The paper develops valid randomization inference for bounded nulls and quantiles of individual effects, including confidence sets obtained by inversion of randomization tests.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Causal Inference 4(1), 2016; author-hosted published manuscript

cvcrand uses constrained allocation spaces and cptest performs a residualized clustered permutation analysis using the saved constrained permutation matrix.
